gpu_tip: ~16GB total at 128K context — the smallest build empero-ai publishes, and the one that makes a 16GB machine viable at all. Quality drops noticeably at 2-bit; prefer IQ3_M or Q3_K_M whenever the memory is there. A 16GB GPU (e.g. RTX 4060 Ti 16GB) is right at the limit at full context; shorten the context or offload a few experts to system RAM for headroom.
mac_tip: Needs ~16GB — right at the limit of a 16GB MacBook Pro (M4 or M5) at full context; a 24GB config is the safe choice.
